nodes.label: source_change_state field separated from document_lifecycle
nodes.rationale: SourceLifecycleRecord.lifecycle (a DocumentLifecycle) does not admit source-change observations like modified/deleted/restored-elsewhere, so a deletion could be written but not re-validated on a later unchanged ingest; splitting document_lifecycle from source_change_state fixes the gap. Legacy values are repaired only via an explicit, versioned compatibility path; unknown values and schema versions fail closed.
